title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Tunnel Handler Dispatch Work Item
summary: Wire accepted RFC 9220 websocket Extended CONNECT request streams to an application-level tunnel handler without ending the stream.
planned_changes:
- Add an `IHttp3WebSocketHandler` server option and a `Http3WebSocketTunnelContext` carrying the decoded request and live bidirectional stream.
- Return validated websocket Extended CONNECT requests after their HEADERS frame instead of waiting for request-stream FIN.
- Send a successful tunnel response HEADERS frame without stream FIN before invoking the handler.
- Add a loopback test that sends a masked client WebSocket message through the accepted tunnel and reads an unmasked server response.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 minimal server WebSocket tunnel test, the RFC 9220 WebSocket parser tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: The HTTP/3 server can now hand an accepted websocket Extended CONNECT stream to application code while preserving the stream for bidirectional tunnel bytes.
